changes.comment: Fix: the Anthropic adapter now sends the adaptive thinking wire shape (thinking.type: 'adaptive' + top-level output_config.effort) for Claude 5 family models (claude-sonnet-5, claude-opus-5, claude-fable-5), which reject the legacy thinking.type: 'enabled' + budget_tokens shape with an HTTP 400. Adds the additive IAiProviderDescriptor.adaptiveThinkingModelPrefixes field and AiAssist.isAdaptiveThinkingModel predicate; legacy models are unaffected.
